needs.reason: junit-jupiter and junit-platform-launcher get their versions from junit-bom 5.11.3 (5.11.3 and 1.11.3, checked on Maven Central). Which plugins and which Java toolchain :domain and :api receive is decided by the precompiled script plugin in buildSrc, which Gradle compiles and applies; a static reader must follow the plugin id inventory.java-conventions to the file name.

traps: Versions are in gradle/libs.versions.toml, not in the build files: libs.guava, libs.jackson.databind and libs.junit.bom are accessors generated from the aliases guava, jackson-databind and junit-bom (dashes become dots). junit-jupiter and junit-launcher have no version in the catalog: the BOM gives it.
The root project has no build.gradle.kts: settings.gradle.kts declares it and its two subprojects.

The Java 21 toolchain is not in any project build file: it comes from the convention plugin buildSrc/src/main/kotlin/inventory.java-conventions.gradle.kts, applied by id inventory.java-conventions (the file name without .gradle.kts).

libs/money is an included build (includeBuild), not a subproject: it has its own settings file, its own Java 17 toolchain and version 0.3.0. :domain asks for com.example.money:money with no version and Gradle substitutes the included build because its group and name match; outside the composite that coordinate does not resolve.
buildSrc is a separate build of build logic, compiled before the main build; its source set holds Gradle Kotlin DSL script plugins, not application code, and it is not a workspace member.
The kotlin-dsl plugin in buildSrc has no version: it is embedded in Gradle 8.11.1.
The foojay resolver plugin lets Gradle download the JDKs 21 and 17 it does not find on the machine.
There is no wrapper in libs/money: inside the composite it runs with the main build's Gradle 8.11.1.

resolved for junit-jupiter (5.11.3) and junit-platform-launcher (1.11.3) is read from junit-bom 5.11.3 as published on Maven Central; guava and jackson-databind have their versions written in the catalog, so they are declared there and resolved stays null.
Workspace members are the subprojects of settings.gradle.kts (domain, api): the root is the workspace root, buildSrc and the included build libs/money are separate builds, not members.
